errors.text_span: Das tatsächliche BIP ist als schwarze Linie mit Punkten über jedem jeweiligen Jahr dargestellt
errors.evidence: The black line represents the total investment of territorial authorities, not the actual GDP.
The description does not mention that the figure shows gross and net investment of territorial authorities as a percentage of GDP.
The description does not mention the vertical axis range (-0.5% to 3.5%) or its unit (percentage of GDP).
The description does not mention that the left chart shows gross investment and the right chart shows net investment.
The description does not mention the trend of gross investment starting above 3% in the early 1990s, declining to around 2.5% by 2000, and stabilizing between 2% and 3% thereafter.
The description does not mention the trend of net investment being significantly lower, starting at 0.7% in the early 1990s, dipping into negative values, and remaining mostly between 0% and 0.5%.
The description does not mention the slight upward trend in net investment after 2015, peaking below 0.6% and ending slightly above zero.
